name: God Helmet (Shiva): chirp both sides, then hippocampus right, 60 min
summary: Murphy's Shiva God Helmet session, 30 + 30 min: a chirp stepped around both temporal lobes, then the hippocampal 'LTP' signal around the right side only. Murphy reports inner silence, deep calm, inner images and possibly a sense of spaciousness. The one lab run (3 people, no sham group) reports no clear pattern of experiences (Collins 2014, ch. 4).
notes: The vendor's page states no length for this session (general rule: 20 to 30 min per phase, index.htm). Persinger's lab ran it once: 20 + 20 min, 3 people, no sham, no clear pattern of experiences (Collins 2014, ch. 4, condition 5; program persinger-collins-gh-c5-chirpbi-hippr). This file runs 30 + 30 min. Neither vendor signal is published, so both are rebuilt. Chirp: this project's stand-in, a 2.5-s sweep from 40 down to 6 Hz and 1.5 s of silence. The vendor's chirp 'does not change in tone' and 'has longer and longer gaps between sections' (experiment_signals.htm); that program plays it as 40 Hz phase-modulated at 5 Hz. Hippocampus: the primed burst drawn in Corradini 2014 Fig. 2 (p.103 [92]), 5-ms pulses at 0, 150, 164, 178 and 192 ms, five times in 1 s, then 4 s of silence. In phase 1 one left-right pair is on at a time, and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head. The four sites per side stand for the lab helmet's four solenoids per side on a 7.5 by 5 cm ellipse; the site names are this project's reading. Each coil is held 125 ms, a project choice (vendor: 'several times per second'). No God Helmet page states a field; the lab measured 1 to 2 uT in the centre of the cap (Collins 2014 p.69 [60]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Anxiety or fear during or after phase 2: do not reuse the session. Not a first session for people prone to anxiety (Murphy). The vendor calls it experimental. Headache or pressure (vendor: about 2% with the hippocampal signal): lower the intensity by a third. Not with a psychiatric diagnosis or medication, epilepsy, migraine, brain injury, drugs or other mind machines. Stop on any distress.
setting: Darkness and acoustic silence; relax without meditating or falling asleep.
schedule: At most once a week; after six sessions, stop for 21 days (the vendor's God Helmet safety page). The rule 'NEVER do the same session two days in a row' is from the vendor's Shakti pages. Do not mix with other Shiva or Shakti sessions in the same weeks (Murphy). Murphy's Shiva pages allow 60-min sessions weekly or every two weeks; his Shakti pages say at most once every 3 weeks.
